title: RNAi in human monocyte-derived dendritic cells using shRNA vectors
protocol: Plate 293T cells at 0.5x10^6 per well in 6-well plates.
Transfect 293T cells with TransIT-293 following the manufacturer's protocol, using 8 µL TransIT-293 and 3 µg total DNA.
Change media to 3 ml per well of 293T culture media.
Isolate mononuclear cells from adult or cord blood on a FicollPAQUE gradient.
Use Miltenyi human CD14+ beads and procedure to isolate CD14+ monocytes and check their purity.
Plate 5x10^6 monocytes in 5 ml MDDC culture media in a 10 cm plate with recombinant human GM-CSF at 10 ng/ml and recombinant human IL-4 at 50 ng/ml.
Add 1 µg/ml polybrene to the cell cultures.
Filter culture supernatants from transfected 293T cells with 0.45 µm yellow filters (Corning).
Add 2.5 ml of helper particle supernatant to the monocytes.
Add 2.5 ml of shRNA particle supernatant to the monocytes.
Add an additional 2.5 ml of fresh MDDC culture media containing GM-CSF and IL-4.
Add an additional 2.5 ml of fresh MDDC culture media containing GM-CSF and IL-4.
Analyze transduction efficiency by cytometry if a lentiviral vector encoding GFP was used.
Check knockdown efficiency by real-time PCR.
Check knockdown efficiency by western blotting.
